general.welcomeDetailed:
Welcome to Status Stock!

Telegram marketplace for buying and selling products.

Seller - create your shop, manage products, receive crypto payments
Buyer - search products, place orders, track delivery

Choose your role:

seller.walletsContext:
Wallets for Receiving Payments

Add your crypto wallet addresses - customer payments will be sent there.

Supported currencies:
BTC (Bitcoin)
ETH (Ethereum)
USDT (Tether TRC-20)
LTC (Litecoin)

You can add all 4 currencies - buyers will choose their preferred one at checkout.
seller.workersContext:
Shop Workers

This feature is only available on PRO tier.

Why use it?
Add employees who can manage products and orders on your behalf. You remain the shop owner.

What workers CAN do:
Add and edit products
View orders
Mark orders as shipped

What workers CANNOT do:
Change shop settings
Manage subscription
Delete shop

migration.intro:
Emergency Channel Migration

Use this feature ONLY if your current channel is blocked by Telegram.

What will happen:
You'll specify a new channel
All your buyers will receive a notification
They'll learn about the new channel via private messages

WARNING: This action cannot be undone!
migration.askChannel:
Channel Migration

Enter @username or link to your NEW channel.

Examples:
@my_new_channel
https://t.me/my_new_channel

After confirmation, all buyers will receive a notification.

Migration Complete

Don't forget to:
Setup the new channel
Add description and avatar
Make the channel public
